deliverables: Allocate capital to builders advancing monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs: monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Coordinate proposal evaluation, feedback, fund distribution, and result tracking through the DAO.
Disburse funds after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds initially received and disbursed by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned to Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is intended to allocate capital to builders who can drive growth in monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 funded 20 companies, involved 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
Round 2 funded 14 companies after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting, with 88% member participation and 18 new members joining the DAO.
The DAO created Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The administrator will hold any ADA in separate community-auditable accounts, will not delegate it to a stake pool, and will delegate voting power to the predefined abstain option.
The Cardano Builder DAO only receives funds after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
Unused or unallocated funds would be returned to the Cardano Treasury, and the proposal cites a transaction showing 354,790 ADA previously returned after the first two governance rounds.

A milestone and budget document is referenced externally, but the anchor text itself does not state the budget breakdown, milestone schedule, feasibility assessment, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, or failure-mode analysis.

summary: The proposal requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale a builder-led, KPI-oriented funding mechanism, citing prior DAO rounds, governance participation, KPI tracking efforts, administrator controls, milestone validation, and a prior unused-funds repayment, while leaving key treasury diligence details outside the anchor text or not stated.
